description:
Position : Web Developer/Web Admin(Remote work Possibility)
 Duration: 6+ months
 Location: Waltham, MA or Gainesville, FL
 Qualifications: 
 Expert level HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript development skills
 Strong foundation with Drupal and WordPress Content Management Systems , including custom module development
 Full knowledge/understanding of the LAMP stack, preferably Ubuntu or CentOS 
 Proficient in cross-browser testing, with working knowledge of browser abilities/limitations
 Proven experience in Mobile Web and Responsive Design/Development 
 Proven knowledge of RESTful interfaces 
 Experience working with Amazon AWS Cloud infrastructure a plus ( EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront , etc)
 Experience working with Adobe Photoshop documents (PSDs) is preferred
 Prior consulting or client service delivery experience is a plus
 Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle and Methodologies
 Experience working in an Agile environment 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 Required: 
 BS in Computer Science or equivalent work experience
 Development experience with Web or Mobile application technologies
 Description: 
 We are seeking an experienced Full-Stack Web Developer with a proven ability to create and maintain high performance, CMS-driven websites for both internal and external clients. 
 Strong foundation in Drupal and WordPress Content Management Systems is a must. 
 Bonus points for those with PSD to HTML layout experience - double bonus points for those with Responsive Design/Development experience. 
 Position is part-time (contract) with little or no travel required.
 You should be located near either our Waltham, MA or Gainesville, FL offices for occasional office visits and collaboration, but can work remotely otherwise .
   
 Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop and maintain custom Drupal/WordPress websites
 Produce HTML5 layouts from PSDs using responsive design/development
 Create custom modules which integrate server-side APIs using JSON, XML and other RESTful interfaces
 Work with IT system administrators to maintain a multi-region, auto-scaling hosting environment within the Amazon AWS cloud infrastructure
